description: The travel Domain Contract, version 2 (ADR 0016, TASK-80). destinations rises to schemaVersion 2: every trip states the person's role on it (led, organised or travelled), so a self-organised trip never reads as leading a group. licences is a new optional group: official tour-leader or guide licences, each with an issuer, a region and a date it is valid until. The record's shape is packages/domains/travel/schema/candidate.schema.json.
